reviewer: Work (agent), criteria written before live outputs; owner review pending

qualityGates.rule: Report denominators by mode and origin. A correct schema alone earns no semantic score. Rejection of every task cannot pass normal usefulness. Missing reviews are NOT TESTED. Any critical violation blocks regardless of averages.

privacy: Public fixture inputs are reproducible evaluation material, not user transcripts. Default logs contain metadata only. Optional separately approved validated result retention: private local files outside Git for at most 24 hours, explicit purge required; no raw provider response retention, CI upload or Production persistence.
limits: Substring/support checks do not establish entailment. Public summaries can themselves be wrong. Rejected raw prose is not saved, so semantic over-rejection diagnosis may remain unavailable. Mock responses establish wiring only, never model quality.
